_comment: Reviewed exceptions to the source-file-size hard limit. Each entry needs an exact maxLines, a rationale, an owner, and a kind. Temporary debt (kind "other") also needs an issue or reviewBy date. See .pi/skills/aikami-conventions/SKILL.md. Remove exceptions as files shrink; the guard fails on obsolete entries.

packages/shared/constants/src/lib/countr.rationale: Cohesive ISO-3166 country/region table: one nested literal per country, consumed as a single lookup dataset. Splitting it would scatter one data structure across files without creating a responsibility boundary.

packages/shared/constants/src/lib/locale.rationale: Cohesive locale registry (one record per locale) consumed as a single lookup table. It is declarative data with no logic; file boundaries would add imports, not cohesion.

packages/shared/lpc/src/lib/legacy_catal.rationale: Generated legacy LPC catalog ordering snapshot (DO NOT hand-edit; regenerated from the test fixture and kept in parity by a test). A single frozen data structure that must not be split because legacy appearance indices depend on its exact order.

packages/shared/utils/src/lib/form/weak_.rationale: Cohesive static password blocklist (top 10000 common passwords, filtered). It is a single reference dataset with no logic; splitting adds imports without creating a responsibility boundary.
